signal: Incode partnered with Interac to add deepfake and injection-attack detection (Q3 2026 launch) and is raising at a reported $3B valuation

email.body1:
Sy'Veon, saw Incode deepened its Interac partnership and is reportedly raising at a $3B valuation.

Momentum like that drives more inbound and outbound targets than an SDR team can follow up on fast, and slow first touches quietly kill conversion. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across email and LinkedIn, so your team covers far more without adding reps, 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through them?
email.body2:
Sy'Veon, quick follow-up for Incode.

Ramp time and response speed are usually where SDR output quietly leaks, and most teams can't actually quantify what slow follow-up is costing them in missed meetings. Our built-in best practices help close that gap: multi-channel sequencing alone drives 287% more responses than single channel, and tighter, sharper emails add another 67% on top.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I'd change, and the lift you'd expect for Incode's SDR team.
email.body3:
Sy'Veon, last bit of proof for Incode.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your SDR team's reply rate likely compares to other identity and fraud-prevention vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Sy'Veon, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If taking follow-up volume off your SDRs isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Scaling a team mid-raise is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I'll tailor it to Incode either way.
